env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A yield statement and a discarded return value keep their whole operands
# when the first one opens with a slice expression, when an operand is
# parenthesised, and when the statement ends in a line or a block comment.
# The module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs
# with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^\[2 4 3 4\]\n2 3\n1 3\n\[1\]$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/yieldoperand

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"iter"
	"slices"
)

func Forms(xs []int) iter.Seq[int] {
	yield xs[1:][0]
	yield xs[0] + xs[1:][1] // trailing
	yield (xs[2])
	yield len(")}//")
}

func Pairs(xs []int) iter.Seq2[int, int] {
	yield xs[1:][0], xs[1:][1] /* block */
	yield (xs[0]), xs[2]
}

func Returned(xs []int) iter.Seq[int] {
	yield xs[0]
	if len(xs) > 1 {
		return slices.Values(xs[1:][:1]) // the value is discarded
	}
}

func main() {
	xs := []int{1, 2, 3}
	fmt.Println(slices.Collect(Forms(xs)))
	for a, b := range Pairs(xs) {
		fmt.Println(a, b)
	}
	fmt.Println(slices.Collect(Returned(xs)))
}
